title: Constructivist Studio

**Theme ID:** `constructivist-studio`

## Summary

Constructivist Studio treats learning as inseparable from making. Learners develop understanding through the process of creating artifacts, receiving critique, revising, and reflecting on their choices. The instructor acts as a studio mentor rather than a lecturer.

## Token Defaults

```yaml
scaffolding.level: medium
agency.mode: bounded-choice
feedback.mode: peer-plus-instructor
assessment.evidence: artifact-plus-reflection
revision.required: true
revision.mode: required-once
reflection.required: true
reflection.focus: creative-choice
collaboration.structure: studio-critique
```

- `project-brief`

## Best For

- Digital arts, animation, design
- Writing and composition
- Media production
- Portfolio-oriented courses
- Any course where artifact quality and creative judgment are goals

## Example Uses

**3D Animation:** Students design and produce a motion graphics sequence over four weeks, receiving critique twice, revising after each, and submitting a reflection on their creative decisions.

**Writing:** Students draft an analytical essay, workshop it in a peer critique session, revise based on feedback, and submit a revision statement alongside the final essay.

## AI Guidance

When applying this theme:
- Preserve learner choice within given constraints
- Include structured critique sessions with explicit criteria
- Require revision that responds to specific feedback points
- Ask learners to explain their creative decisions in a reflection
- Do not reduce the feedback phase to a single round of instructor-only comments
- Generate critique worksheets that name specific aspects of the work to evaluate
